vectors.description: RequestMediaTicket, an empty message, decoding on both codecs and re-encoding to the same golden (zero-length) bytes (docs/protocol/SPEC.md #media-ticket).

MediaTicketGrant with a 32-byte ticket and expiresAt 30 s after issuance decoding to identical fields on both codecs and re-encoding to the same golden bytes (docs/protocol/SPEC.md #media-ticket "Issuance").

MediaHello with a 32-byte ticket and a 16-byte mirrorSessionId decoding to the same fields on both codecs and re-encoding to the same golden bytes (docs/protocol/SPEC.md #media-ticket "Consumption and single use").
MirrorRequest, an empty message, decoding on both codecs and re-encoding to the same golden (zero-length) bytes (docs/protocol/SPEC.md #mirror-request).
MirrorDeclined, an empty message, decoding on both codecs and re-encoding to the same golden (zero-length) bytes (docs/protocol/SPEC.md #mirror-request).
A MediaHello with no ticket field (empty message) MUST be rejected TICKET_REJECTED/MISSING by both parsers before any further frame is read (docs/protocol/SPEC.md #media-ticket, case 0).
A MediaHello whose ticket is 31 bytes (one short) MUST be rejected TICKET_REJECTED/MISSING by both parsers (docs/protocol/SPEC.md #media-ticket, case 0).
A MediaHello whose ticket is 33 bytes (one over) MUST be rejected TICKET_REJECTED/MISSING by both parsers (docs/protocol/SPEC.md #media-ticket, case 0).
A MediaHello with a valid ticket and no mirrorSessionId MUST be rejected MALFORMED_FRAME by both parsers (docs/protocol/SPEC.md #mirror-request).
A MediaHello whose mirrorSessionId is 15 bytes MUST be rejected MALFORMED_FRAME by both parsers (docs/protocol/SPEC.md #mirror-request).
A MediaHello whose mirrorSessionId is 17 bytes MUST be rejected MALFORMED_FRAME by both parsers (docs/protocol/SPEC.md #mirror-request).
